entries.name: s
entries.help: Which sound plays: a drum (bd sd hh oh cp ...), a synth (sine saw square tri supersaw subbass fm) or a folder in Documents\Devil-DJ\Samples. "bd:2" picks number 2.

entries.name: sound
entries.help: The same as s().

entries.name: n
entries.help: A number per event: the sample in a folder, a scale degree (with scale), or a synth's pitch above middle C.

entries.name: note
entries.help: The pitch: a note name (c3, f#4, eb) or a MIDI number. c3 = 48, a4 = 69.

entries.name: gain
entries.help: Loudness, 0 to 1.5 (1 = as it is).

entries.name: pan
entries.help: Left (0) to right (1); 0.5 is the middle.

entries.name: speed
entries.help: Playback rate of a sample, -4 to 4. 2 is an octave up, negative plays backwards.

entries.name: lpf
entries.help: Low-pass filter: cuts what is above this frequency.

entries.name: cutoff
entries.help: The same as lpf().

entries.name: hpf
entries.help: High-pass filter: cuts what is below this frequency.

entries.name: resonance
entries.help: How much the filter rings at its frequency, 0 to 1.

entries.name: attack
entries.help: How long a note takes to reach full level.

entries.name: decay
entries.help: How long it falls from full level to the sustain level.

entries.name: sustain
entries.help: The level held while the note lasts, 0 to 1.

entries.name: release
entries.help: How long it fades after the note ends.

entries.name: legato
entries.help: How long a note lasts compared to its step: 1 fills the step, 0.5 half of it.

entries.name: room
entries.help: Reverb send, 0 to 1.

entries.name: delay
entries.help: Echo send, 0 to 1 (3/16 of a bar).

entries.name: crush
entries.help: Bit crush: 16 is clean, 4 is rough.

entries.name: cut
entries.help: Sounds in the same group stop each other (an open hat cut by a closed one).

entries.name: bank
entries.help: A sound bank name, kept with the events (for later sound banks).

entries.name: pure
entries.help: One value, once per cycle.

entries.name: silence
entries.help: Nothing at all.

entries.name: seq
entries.help: Everything in one cycle, one after another.

entries.name: fastcat
entries.help: The same as seq().

entries.name: cat
entries.help: One per cycle, in turn.

entries.name: slowcat
entries.help: The same as cat().

entries.name: stack
entries.help: All at the same time.

entries.name: timecat
entries.help: Steps with lengths: [3, a] takes three times as long as [1, b].

entries.name: mini
entries.help: A pattern from mini-notation, without a control.

entries.name: run
entries.help: 0, 1, 2 ... n-1 in one cycle.

entries.name: euclid
entries.help: Plays the pattern on an even spread of pulses over steps.

entries.name: signal
entries.help: Your own continuous signal from a function of time (in cycles).

entries.name: sine
entries.help: A smooth wave from 0 to 1 and back over a cycle. Use .range(lo, hi) to scale it.

entries.name: cosine
entries.help: Like sine, a quarter cycle earlier.

entries.name: saw
entries.help: Rises from 0 to 1 over each cycle.

entries.name: isaw
entries.help: Falls from 1 to 0 over each cycle.

entries.name: tri
entries.help: Up from 0 to 1 and down again over a cycle.

entries.name: square
entries.help: 0 for the first half of the cycle, 1 for the second.

entries.name: rand
entries.help: A random value at every moment - the same every time you play it (see .seed).

entries.name: irand
entries.help: Random whole numbers 0 to n-1.

entries.name: perlin
entries.help: Smooth randomness that wanders slowly.

entries.name: range
entries.help: Scales a 0-1 signal to lo..hi.

entries.name: segment
entries.help: Samples a signal n times per cycle, giving steps.

entries.name: fast
entries.help: Plays the pattern this many times faster.

entries.name: slow
entries.help: Plays the pattern this many times slower.

entries.name: early
entries.help: Shifts the pattern earlier by part of a cycle.

entries.name: late
entries.help: Shifts the pattern later by part of a cycle.

entries.name: rev
entries.help: Plays each cycle backwards.

entries.name: every
entries.help: Changes every n-th cycle (cycles 0, n, 2n ...).

entries.name: whenCycle
entries.help: Changes the cycles where the test is true.

entries.name: iter
entries.help: Starts each cycle a step further in.

entries.name: palindrome
entries.help: Forwards, then backwards, in turn.

entries.name: ply
entries.help: Plays every event n times in its own time.

entries.name: superimpose
entries.help: Plays a changed copy on top of the pattern.

entries.name: layer
entries.help: Plays several changed copies together (not the original).

entries.name: off
entries.help: A changed copy, shifted later, on top.

entries.name: degradeBy
entries.help: Drops events at random with this chance (0 to 1).

entries.name: degrade
entries.help: Drops about half the events at random.

entries.name: sometimesBy
entries.help: Changes events at random with this chance.

entries.name: sometimes
entries.help: Changes about half the events.

entries.name: often
entries.help: Changes about three in four events.

entries.name: rarely
entries.help: Changes about one in four events.

entries.name: seed
entries.help: Another set of random choices (the same seed, the same choices).

entries.name: struct
entries.help: Plays the pattern's values on this rhythm.

entries.name: mask
entries.help: Mutes the parts where the mask is 0.

entries.name: add
entries.help: Adds to numbers or notes (+12 is an octave up).

entries.name: sub
entries.help: Subtracts from numbers or notes.

entries.name: mul
entries.help: Multiplies numbers.

entries.name: div
entries.help: Divides numbers.

entries.name: scale
entries.help: Turns degrees (n) into notes in a scale: major minor dorian phrygian lydian mixolydian locrian harmonicMinor melodicMinor majPent minPent blues chromatic.

entries.name: hurry
entries.help: Faster and higher (fast and speed together).

entries.name: fmap
entries.help: Changes every value with your own function.

entries.name: play
entries.help: Plays a pattern; named ones can be muted. Everything played plays together.

entries.name: mute
entries.help: Silences a named play() (it stays muted until unmute).

entries.name: unmute
entries.help: Lets a muted play() be heard again.

entries.name: hush
entries.help: Stops everything at once (Ctrl+. does the same).

entries.name: setbpm
entries.help: Asks for a tempo, 20 to 300 (only when the code deck leads the clock).

entries.name: setcpb
entries.help: Beats per cycle (4 by default: a cycle is a bar).

entries.name: print
entries.help: Shows values under the editor.

entries.name: deckA
entries.help: Deck A now (read only): its tempo, key, beat, bar, phrase and whether it plays.

entries.name: deckB
entries.help: Deck B now (read only).

entries.name: deckC
entries.help: Deck C now (read only).

entries.name: deckD
entries.help: Deck D now (read only).

entries.name: master
entries.help: The master clock now (read only).
